title: Octopus holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- heart held above -->
  <path d='M50 22 C46 14, 36 14, 34 21 C32 28, 40 34, 50 42 C60 34, 68 28, 66 21 C64 14, 54 14, 50 22 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M44 20 C42 18, 39 18, 38 21' stroke='#ffd1dc' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M32 70 C22 74, 18 82, 24 88' stroke='#c05299' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 74 C34 82, 34 90, 40 94' stroke='#c05299' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 76 C50 84, 50 90, 50 95' stroke='#c05299' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 74 C66 82, 66 90, 60 94' stroke='#c05299' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 70 C78 74, 82 82, 76 88' stroke='#c05299' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#e05fb0'/>
  <!-- two arms reaching to heart -->
  <path d='M38 40 C40 34, 44 30, 48 28' stroke='#e05fb0' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 40 C60 34, 56 30, 52 28' stroke='#e05fb0' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#3b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#3b1a4a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#ff9bc8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#ff9bc8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 65 Q50 70 54 65' stroke='#3b1a4a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
